1) 2012-10-14: White 1 (白1) with others, after conflict, they go to a hair salon, then encounter Sun (孙) and Wang (王) outside mall, a fight, 白1 uses a knife to stab Sun and Wang, both suffer serious injuries (重伤二级). That's intentional injury (故意伤害) causing serious injury. Also possibly "持刀行凶" but the crime is intentional injury. Also maybe "聚众斗殴"? But they used a knife, so it's intentional injury. Could also be "寻衅滋事"? But the main is intentional injury.

2) 2013-10-15: White 1 with others (王1, 王3, 郭) assault Dong (董) at a bathhouse, beat him, then abduct him, tie him with tape, transport to a riverbank, tie to a tree, beat again. Victim suffers light injury (轻伤二级). This is kidnapping/illegal detention? They forcibly took him, bound him, detained. That could be "非法拘禁" (illegal detention) or "绑架"? The facts: they abducted him, tied him, but no ransom. It's illegal detention (非法拘禁) or "强迫他人" maybe "非法拘禁". Also assault causing injury: intentional injury (轻伤). So crimes: illegal detention and intentional injury.

Thus final answer.
